description:
Diona is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

Despite being a bartender at the Cat's Tail , she loathes alcohol and will stop at nothing to ruin Mondstadt 's wine industry — a feat easier said than done when her patrons absolutely love her drinks. She is the daughter of Draff , a hunter in Springvale .
role_summary: Diona is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Kätzlein Style
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow. Charged Attack Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG. While aiming, biting frost will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged frost arrow will deal Cryo DMG . Plunging Attack Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Icy Paws
talents.description: Fires an Icy Paw that deals Cryo DMG to opponents and forms a shield on hit. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Diona's Max HP, and its duration scales off the number of Icy Paws that hit their target. (‍ Press Text for mouse and keyboard and controller ‍/‍ Tap Text for touch screen ‍) Rapidly fires off 2 Icy Paws. Hold Dashes back quickly before firing 5 Icy Paws. The shield created by a Hold attack will gain a 75% DMG Absorption Bonus. The shield has a 250% Cryo DMG Absorption Bonus, and will cause your active character to become affected by Cryo at the point of formation for a short duration.

talents.name: Signature Mix
talents.description: Tosses out a special cold brew that deals AoE Cryo DMG and creates a Drunken Mist in an AoE . Drunken Mist Deals continuous Cryo DMG to opponents within the AoE. Continuously regenerates the HP of characters within the AoE.

talents.name: Cat's Tail Secret Menu
talents.description: Characters shielded by Icy Paws have their Movement SPD increased by 10% and their Stamina Consumption decreased by 10%.

talents.name: Drunkards' Farce
talents.description: Opponents who enter the AoE of Signature Mix have 10% decreased ATK for 15s.

talents.name: Complimentary Bar Food
talents.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects , Diona has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

c1.name: A Lingering Flavor
c1.effect: Description Preview Regenerates 15 Energy for Diona after the effects of Signature Mix end. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation A Lingering Flavor.mp4

c2.name: Shaken, Not Purred
c2.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview Increases Icy Paws ' DMG by 15%, and increases its shield's DMG Absorption by 15%. Additionally, when paws hit their targets, creates a shield for other nearby characters on the field with 50% of the Icy Paws shield's DMG Absorption for 5s. Icy Paws does not need to hit an enemy for co-op teammates to gain a shield. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation Shaken, Not Purred.mp4

c3.name: A—Another Round?
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Signature Mix by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Wine Industry Slayer
c4.effect: Within the radius of Signature Mix , Diona's charge time for aimed shots is reduced by 60%

c5.name: Double Shot, on the Rocks
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Icy Paws by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Cat's Tail Closing Time
c6.effect: Characters within Signature Mix 's radius will gain the following effects based on their HP amounts: Increases Incoming Healing Bonus by 30% when HP falls below or is equal to 50%. Elemental Mastery increased by 200 when HP is above 50%.
